title: Bound the common coframe for two chart-32 P104 exchange triads
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Exact comparator #7334 at `aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace` with signed #7113 at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`.

The two exact chart-32 signed ADD/SCALE/ADD triads use roles (319,35) and (1081,807). Two independent contact walks check their signed matrices, fixed role IDs and nearest outside boundaries. All four placements at charts 3 or 355 fail the required nesting. The peers have outer charts 32 and 350. The incoming join and outgoing intersection both equal the rank-one span of chart 32, generated by 50. Thus any common coframe under these fixed boundaries preserves the same three paid rank-one legs. There is no unresolved coframe in this scope.

The directed quote includes the compensating peer legs and gives a two-site relaxed upper of 0.5589215181385728 raw before the topology check. That relaxation grants both sites compatibility. The exact coframe proof leaves no paid-profile saving.

## Task and overlap

This is a changed `p104-side-correction` scope with a jointly rerouted peer and fixed external role IDs. #7338 inventories the 1081 pair under a virtual-owned model and excludes protected role 319 from that stock. Its scope does not cover this fixed-boundary common coframe. #7371 and #7372 use fixed peer routes on different two-ADD blocks. The research commit adds only `research/p104-chart32-triad-coframe-bound/`. The existing #7257 commits address the canonical CI navigation mismatch documented in #7371.

## Validation

Run from a clean checkout with CPython 3.12.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-chart32-triad-coframe-bound/replay.py
```

The Git-free replay authenticates the #7365 and #7362 manifests, regenerates the price and both exact contact walks, and compares all four endpoint exclusions and the uniform rank-one coframe proof. Four changed-input controls reject. Registered-package, source-history, navigation and export checks passed. No physical prototype was needed.

## Credit and open next questions

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact native word and signed caller. #7365 and #7362 supply the exact public stock receipts. #7338 supplies virtual-owned overlap. #7003, #7004, #2725 and #6529 supply chronology, paired recharting and scale precedents. #7298 supplies the tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

A changed outer contact or a compensating route would need a new complete price before construction. Review and merge are left to the maintainers.
